context: Implementation choices for the repo_ids fix: private declaredRepoId helper in v3-forward (no cross-layer import), finalize extends an existing store.json rather than replacing it, and the migrate cases live in a new single test file.
rationale: v3-forward.test.ts is 650+ lines with a SIGKILL harness; a dedicated file keeps the four reuse cases in one vitest process as the task asked, and calling ensureStoreDescriptor rather than hand-writing JSON pins the real producer shape (asserted: no repo_id key) so a future writer change is caught here.
summary: Chose a new test/migrate/v3-identity-reuse.test.ts (identity-init via the real ensureStoreDescriptor, then migrateStatus / migrate --to 3 / shared-store / rerun) plus test/retrieval/store-identity.test.ts, over extending v3-forward.test.ts
